DEFENCE OF PAKISTAN RULES 1965
DEFENCE
OF PAKISTAN RULES 1965
(Amendments)
[Gazette
of Pakistan, Extraordinary, 13th January 1966]
No. DC-II 9/3/66. In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Defence
of Pakistan Ordinance, 1965 (XXIII of 1965), the Central Government is pleased
to direct that the following further amendments shall be made in the Defence of Pakistan Rules, namely:
In the aforesaid Rules, in rule
182,
(a) in
sub-rule (1), after the words "one or more", the words and comma
"Additional Custodians", shall be inserted; and
(b) in
sub-rule (5), after the word "includes", the words and comma "an
Additional Custodian of Enemy Property", shall be inserted.
